person.persName: البخاري, محمد بن اسماعيل بن ابراهيم بن المغيرة بن بردزبه ابو عبد الله الجعفي
al-Buḫārī, Muḥammad b. Ismāʻīl b. Ibrāhīm b. al-Muġīra b. Bardizbah Abū ʻAbd Allāh al-Ǧuʻfī
person.floruit: 3rd/9th century (b. 194/810, d. 256/870)One of the most important traditionists and author of one of the 6 canonical compilations of ḥadīṯ. He began to learn traditions by heart at the age of ten. He had a remarkable memory, and companions of his are said to have corrected traditions they had written down from what he recited by heart. At the age of sixteen he made the Pilgrimage to Mecca with his mother and his brother, and when they returned he remained for a time in the Ḥiǧāz. He travelled widely in search of traditions, visiting the main centres from Ḫurāsān to Egypt, and claimed to have heard traditions from over 1000 šayḫs.
